svg.title: One flat map for two curved sheets
svg.desc: Schematic, not computed from the robot. Two shaded curved sheets float one above the other over a flat grid, their shared map. A straight dashed line on the map appears on each sheet as a different curved route; dotted verticals join the ends of the routes down to the map.
svg.text: ONE FLAT MAP FOR TWO CURVED SHEETS / SCHEMATIC
Solid: route on each sheet · dashed: the same route on the map
Route length 1.87 on the map · 2.13 and 2.00 on the sheets
